quarterly_data.quarter: Aehr Test Systems press release: Aehr Receives $22 Million Follow-On Order for AI Processor (08-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Aehr received a $22 million follow-on production order from its lead wafer-level AI processor customer (not named; described as a leading provider of advanced AI training and inference processors) for multiple fully automated FOX-XP wafer-level burn-in systems, each configured to test and burn in nine 300 mm wafers simultaneously, plus FOX WaferPak full-wafer contactors and integrated WaferPak Auto Aligners. Aehr expects to ship the systems over the next six months for installation at the customer's high-volume manufacturing partner in Taiwan. CEO Gayn Erickson: the customer's current production plans contemplate capacity beyond this order, and Aehr continues to engage with additional semiconductor companies and hyperscalers following positive wafer-level benchmark results; he attributes the interest in part to AI packages combining high-value processors, HBM and other die, where screening before final assembly avoids committing HBM, substrates and interposers to devices that later fail.
quarterly_data.figure: $22 million follow-on order; nine 300 mm wafers per FOX-XP system; shipping over the next six months
